name: Storm watch
summary: Storms in NASA IMERG rain data, tracked over 24 hours. Click a storm or press N to hear it: north sounds higher, bigger storms louder.
author: itay
description: Follow individual storms through 48 half-hourly IMERG frames, tracked offline with computer vision (OpenCV optical flow and watershed). Click a storm, or press N and P on the map, to hear it (hovering only names it): north sounds higher, bigger storms louder. Enter follows a storm, and when storms merge and split the whole family stays marked; Page Up and Page Down step through time. The full tracking studio with tuning sliders is linked from the panel. From itay's clustering branch.
